topic: corpus-recall skill (corpus recall of yubi-OS/knowledge corpora)

subtopics.scope: The knowledge/<ref>/ corpus anatomy: authored docs, README charter, and the research-db/ provenance directory (archive.json, digs, preflight, outline, jev-log, db.ts)
Path 1: mirroring the whole repo via the codeload tarball (curl -sL, no API budget, ~1s fetch) and grepping it with rg, including scripts/recall.sh and its index.tsv
seed_queries: github codeload tarball download without api rate limits
ripgrep rg recursive text search repository

subtopics.scope: Path 2: one-call full-text retrieval via POST /api/repo-items on the steady-orbit worker (824 items, full text + paths, ~1s, 7.3 MB response)
seed_queries: cloudflare workers.dev subdomain custom api endpoints
full text search api endpoint over repository text items

subtopics.scope: Path 3: single-doc raw reads from raw.githubusercontent.com (no auth, no budget, known-path reads)
seed_queries: raw.githubusercontent.com serving raw files from github repositories
github raw content url rate limits versus api

subtopics.scope: Provenance discipline: inline citations with jev weights, citing doc paths when recalling facts, and cross-checking research-db/archive.json for the original URL's weight and collection date
seed_queries: research provenance citation discipline data sourcing
data provenance evidence weight scoring research archive
